template.name: Landledger: tool or seat cost
template.description: A paid seat is spend: when someone asks Landbright for access to a bundle whose app costs a seat, this flow finds the Landledger contract that grants the app and raises a tool_or_seat request for one seat at the contract's price, naming the person (who confirms it in Landledger). Landledger's approvers decide the cost and Landbright's the access; the flow tells Landbright what Landledger decided (a note on the request, and its cost gate settled, behind a setting until Landbright's spec 008 merges), marks the seat used when the grant is live, raises the cost after break-glass, lets an extension ride on the first request's seat or raises its own, asks the approvers to revoke a grant whose cost was not approved (counting the seat in use until they do), and cancels the cost request or gives the seat back when access is denied, the gate runs out, or the grant is revoked. Every hour it reconciles what a stopped run or a race left behind.

credentials.name: Landledger (requests)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read and requests:write (it raises, marks applied and releases its own requests). Never decisions:relay or admin.

credentials.name: Landledger (webhooks)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with webhooks:write only: the Landledger Trigger subscribes itself on publish. Or the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made.

credentials.name: Landbright events
credentials.description: JWT Auth with key type JWKS: Landbright's <issuer>/jwks, its issuer and the subscription's audience. No secret is shared.

credentials.name: Landbright API
credentials.description: OAuth2 client credentials of the Landflow application in Landbright (in dev landflow-local), with requests:read, annotations:write and steps:settle; the bundle's cost gate must name this application in settledBy.

setup: Pick or add **Landledger (requests)**: an `ll_` key with `read` and `requests:write`, and **Landledger (webhooks)** for **Landledger events**: a key of its own with only `webhooks:write`.

Pick or add **Landbright events** (JWT Auth against Landbright's JWKS) and **Landbright API** (the Landflow application's client credentials: `requests:read`, `annotations:write`, `steps:settle`; the bundle's cost gate names it in `settledBy`).

In **Settings**, set `LANDBRIGHT_URL` and `LANDLEDGER_CONSOLE_URL`. Landbright says what a request costs (a bundle target's `cost: { kind: seat, landbrightApp }`); `SEAT_APPS` maps bundles only for a Landbright without that.

Publish, then subscribe **Landbright events**' production URL in Landbright (Events) to `request.created`, `request.decided`, `grant.activated`, `grant.revoked` and `grant.expired`. Publishing subscribes **Landledger events** to `request.decided` for `tool_or_seat` requests.

A request for a seat: **Find the contract** (Contract → Seats); none → a note on the Landbright request and nothing raised; else **Ask Landledger for the seat** (one seat at the contract's price, idempotency key `landbright-<REQ-n>`), recorded in **Landledger seat requests**, and a note on the Landbright request. A 409 for that key (a redelivered event, or a run that stopped after Create) is looked up by the request Landledger names, or by its origin, and recorded.

Landledger's decision: **Ours to act on?** trusts only this key's request from a run of this workflow, then **Tell Landbright the cost** notes it on the Landbright request, and **Settle the cost gate** answers the gate: `POST /api/v1/requests/:id/steps/0/settle { outcome: approve | deny, reference: { system: Landledger, id, url }, reason }`. Verified against Landbright's PR #5 (spec 008), not merged yet: `SETTLE_IN_LANDBRIGHT` stays off until it is.

Break-glass: Landbright grants at once and skips the gate, so the cost is raised afterwards with the Landbright request as its origin (`breakGlass`), never settled, and marked used once Landledger approves it. Rejected: Landbright has no route for an application to revoke a grant, so **Ask the approvers to revoke** puts a task on the Landbright request (`landflow.seat_revoke`, naming its approvers) and **Landledger unpaid seats** counts the seat in use until the grant is revoked or expires.

An extension (Landbright's `extends`) at the gate rides on the first request's seat, recorded and settled at once citing it, when the first seat is held, the grant is live and the new end is before the contract's renewal; otherwise it gets a seat request of its own. An extension approved after its grant ended gets a new grant, and a seat request of its own on `grant.activated`.

Landbright's decision or a grant change: `grant.activated` → **Mark the seat used** (Request → Mark Applied); access denied, or the gate run out (`request.decided`, `expired`, `waitedOn: Landledger`): a cost request not yet decided → **Cancel the cost request**, an approved one → **Release the seat** (`access_denied`); the grant revoked or expired → **Release the seat** (`grant_revoked`, or `not_needed` for a seat never used).

**Every hour** reconciles: a seat request with no row is recorded, a decision Landbright was never told is noted (and settled when the setting is on), a cost request whose Landbright request ended first is cancelled, and an unpaid seat's task is closed once its grant has gone.

workflow.name: Landledger: tool or seat cost
workflow.description: A paid seat is spend: when someone asks Landbright for access to a bundle whose app costs a seat, this flow finds the Landledger contract that grants the app and raises a tool_or_seat request for one seat at the contract's price, naming the person (who confirms it in Landledger). nodes.name: Landbright events
nodes.notes: Subscribe this URL in Landbright (Events) to request.created, request.decided, grant.activated, grant.revoked and grant.expired. The event is the signed JWT's, checked against Landbright's JWKS.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Landbright's URL, which bundles cost a seat, and whether to settle Landbright's cost step (off until Landbright builds it).

nodes.name: Find the contract
nodes.notes: Contract → Seats: the contract that grants the app, its seat price and seats left; found: false when none does.

nodes.name: Ask Landledger for the seat

parameters.title: {{ $json.contract.vendor }} seat for {{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.subject }} ({{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref }})
parameters.note: Access to {{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.bundle }} in Landbright ({{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref }}){{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.about }} takes a {{ $json.contract.vendor }} {{ $json.contract.product }} seat: {{ $json.left }} left on the contract.{{ $json.why ? ' It needs a seat of its own: ' + $json.why + '.' : '' }}
parameters.evidence: {{ { lines: [{ label: $json.contract.vendor + ' ' + $json.contract.product + ' seat', amount: $json.seatPrice }], basis: 'The contract\'s price per seat a month', links: [{ label: $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref, url: $('Costs a seat?').first().json.url }] } }}

requestFields.originTitle: Tool or seat cost (Landbright {{ $('Costs a seat?').first().json.ref }})

nodes.notes: Raised by this flow's key naming the person who asked: they confirm it in Landledger, then the cost center's owner decides with the seats left in front of them. The idempotency key is the Landbright request, so a retried run raises it once. After break-glass, the Landbright request is the origin with breakGlass (Landledger's exceptions report lists it until approved).

nodes.name: Remember the seat request
nodes.notes: Which run raised which seat request, and for which Landbright request: the decision and the grant are matched through it. The run is the one Landledger's origin names (this one, or the one a 409 found again).

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: 'cost_asked', landledgerRequest: $('Seat request in hand').first().json.number, landledgerRequestId: $('Seat request in hand').first().json.landledgerRequestId, text: 'The seat\'s cost is asked in Landledger as ' + $('Seat request in hand').first().json.number + ($('Costs a seat?').first().json.breakGlass ? ', after break-glass granted the access.' : $('Costs a seat?').first().json.newGrant ? ', after Landbright gave this extension a new grant (its grant had ended).' : '; its approvers decide the cost, Landbright\'s the access.') } } }}

nodes.name: No contract: say so in Landbright

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: 'no_contract', app: $json.landbrightApp, text: 'No Landledger contract grants ' + $json.landbrightApp + ': Finance imports the contract first. No cost request was raised.' } } }}

nodes.name: Get the request
nodes.notes: Read it fresh: the webhook's copy is not what the checks trust.

nodes.name: Find the run that raised it
Tell Landbright the cost

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: $json.outcome === 'approved' ? 'cost_approved' : 'cost_denied', landledgerRequest: $json.number, landledgerRequestId: $json.landledgerRequestId, reason: $json.reason, text: $json.outcome === 'approved' ? 'Landledger approved the seat\'s cost (' + $json.number + '); the seat is reserved. Landbright\'s approvers still decide the access.' : 'Landledger did not approve the seat\'s cost (' + $json.number + '): ' + $json.reason } } }}

nodes.notes: A note on the Landbright request (annotation landflow.seat_cost), shown on its page. Until Landbright has an external cost step, this is all the flow can tell it: access and cost are decided apart.

nodes.name: Read the gate

parameters.url: {{ $('Ours to act on?').first().json.landbrightUrl }}/api/v1/requests/{{ $('Ours to act on?').first().json.landbrightRequestId }}

nodes.notes: Landbright's request as it stands: is its cost gate (step 0) still waiting on Landledger?

nodes.name: Settle the cost gate
nodes.notes: Landbright's cost gate (spec 008, PR #5): POST /api/v1/requests/:id/steps/0/settle { outcome: approve | deny, reference: { system: 'Landledger', id, url }, reason }, scope steps:settle, only by the application the gate's settledBy names. Behind SETTLE_IN_LANDBRIGHT (off) until the PR merges.

nodes.name: Mark the seat used (granted first)
nodes.notes: Landbright granted the access before the cost was approved (break-glass, or an extension's new grant): the seat is in use already.

nodes.name: Nothing to settle
nodes.notes: What Landbright needs says why: the setting is off, the request has no gate, break-glass skipped it, or it was settled already.

nodes.name: Not this flow's: refused
nodes.notes: Ours to act on? says why: another key raised it, its origin is forged or another workflow's, or it is not approved any more. Nothing is told to Landbright.

nodes.name: Find its seat request
nodes.notes: The newest seat request recorded for this Landbright request (an extension may have two: the first request's it rode on, then its own).

nodes.name: Mark the seat used
nodes.notes: Landledger: approved → applied; the seat moves from reserved to used.

nodes.name: Cancel the cost request
nodes.notes: Landbright ended the request (denied, cancelled, or its gate ran out waiting on Landledger) before Landledger decided: the cost request is withdrawn.

nodes.name: Release the seat
nodes.notes: The seat goes back to the contract and the request's reservations are released (Landledger sends seat.released).

nodes.name: This key's seat requests
nodes.notes: Only when Landledger's 409 named no request: this key's seat requests, to find the one whose origin is this Landbright request.

nodes.name: Find the first seat request
nodes.notes: The seat request this flow raised for the request the extended grant came from.

nodes.name: Read the grant
nodes.notes: The grant the extension adds time to: still active, and when it ends now.

nodes.name: Ride, or a seat of its own
Link it to the first seat request
nodes.notes: The extension's Landbright request, linked to the seat request it rides on: if Landbright later answers it with a new grant, What the seat needs sees the link and raises a seat request of its own.

parameters.url: {{ $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.landbrightUrl }}/api/v1/requests/{{ $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.landbrightRequestId }}/annotations/landflow.seat_cost
parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: 'cost_rides', landledgerRequest: $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.number, landledgerRequestId: $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.landledgerRequestId, firstRequest: $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.firstRef, newEnd: $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.newEnd, renewal: $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.renewal, text: $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.text } } }}

nodes.name: Settle the extension's gate

parameters.url: {{ $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.landbrightUrl }}/api/v1/requests/{{ $('Extension or new seat?').first().json.landbrightRequestId }}/steps/0/settle

nodes.notes: Approve, citing the first seat request: behind SETTLE_IN_LANDBRIGHT, off until Landbright's spec 008 merges.

nodes.name: Ask the approvers to revoke

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: 'open', task: 'revoke_grant', assignees: $json.approvers, landledgerRequest: $json.number, landledgerRequestId: $json.landledgerRequestId, landbrightRequestId: $json.landbrightRequestId, ref: $json.ref, app: $json.app, contractId: $json.contractId, reason: $json.reason, since: $json.since, text: $json.taskText } } }}

nodes.notes: A task on the Landbright request (annotation landflow.seat_revoke, status open), naming the request's approvers: Landbright's machine API has no route to revoke a grant (POST /api/access/grants/:id/revoke is for administrators and the holder), so a person revokes it. Landbright shows it on the request's page.

nodes.name: Count the seat in use, unpaid
nodes.notes: Landledger counts no seat for a request it did not approve, so the seat in use is counted here until its grant is revoked.

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: 'done', task: 'revoke_grant', landledgerRequest: $json.number, landledgerRequestId: $json.landledgerRequestId, landbrightRequestId: $json.landbrightRequestId, ref: $json.ref, app: $json.app, contractId: $json.contractId, since: $json.since, endedAt: $json.endedAt, text: $json.closeText } } }}

nodes.name: Every hour
nodes.notes: Reconcile: seat requests with no row (a run that stopped after Create), decisions Landbright was never told, cancels that raced a Create, and unpaid seats whose grant has gone.

parameters.body: {{ { value: { status: $json.outcome === 'approved' ? 'cost_approved' : 'cost_denied', landledgerRequest: $json.number, landledgerRequestId: $json.landledgerRequestId, reason: $json.reason, text: $json.outcome === 'approved' ? 'Landledger approved the seat\'s cost (' + $json.number + '); the seat is reserved. Landbright\'s approvers still decide the access.' : 'Landledger did not approve the seat\'s cost (' + $json.number + '): ' + $json.reason } } }}

nodes.name: Settle the gate (reconcile)
nodes.notes: Behind SETTLE_IN_LANDBRIGHT, as Settle the cost gate. A 409 (the request moved on) is left on the item.
